title: Etale representations assemble on disjoint scheme components
statement: Let $I$ be a type in the universe of schemes, $T$ a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and $E$ a sheaf of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets] on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let $U_i$ be etale $T$-schemes and $Q_i$ etale $U_i$-schemes. Put $B=\coprod_i U_i$ and $V=\coprod_i Q_i$, with their canonical structure maps $B\to T$ and $\pi:V\to B$, and assume these maps are etale. Suppose each restriction $E|_{U_i}$, transported to the small etale site of $U_i$, is isomorphic as a presheaf to the lifted Yoneda presheaf of the chosen $Q_i$. Then $E|_B$, transported to the small etale site of $B$, is isomorphic to the lifted Yoneda presheaf of the explicit etale $B$-scheme $(V,\pi)$. No finiteness condition or surjectivity of $B\to T$ is assumed. Empty $I$ is allowed.

proof.text: Form B as the coproduct of U_i and V as the coproduct of Q_i, with the morphism pi = Sigma.map(Q_i.hom). For each i its component square is cartesian: the inverse image of U_i in V is Q_i, by disjointness and the coproduct universal property. For etale W over B, the W_i = W times_B U_i cover W and are disjoint open subschemes.

Transport E.over B to the small etale site of B. Its sections on W_i are the sections of E on W_i to U_i to T. The assumed local representation identifies these sections with morphisms W_i to Q_i over U_i. The component pullback identifies those morphisms with maps W_i to V over B.

The disjoint-cover sheaf axiom identifies sections of the transported sheaf on W with the product of its sections on the W_i. Apply the same axiom to the representable etale presheaf of V. Compose these two product identifications with the local representation isomorphisms. Restriction along W prime to W commutes with the component pullbacks and with the local representation maps; uniqueness of gluing proves naturality. Gluing the inverses gives inverse maps. For empty indices every W is empty, and the empty-cover axiom gives singleton section sets.
